Package au.csiro.pathling.vcl.generated

Class VclBaseVisitor<T>

java.lang.Object
org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.AbstractParseTreeVisitor<T>
au.csiro.pathling.vcl.generated.VclBaseVisitor<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The return type of the visit operation. Use Void for operations with no return type.
All Implemented Interfaces:
VclVisitor<T>, org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeVisitor<T>
public class VclBaseVisitor<T> extends org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.AbstractParseTreeVisitor<T> implements VclVisitor<T>
This class provides an empty implementation of VclVisitor, which can be extended to create a visitor which only needs to handle a subset of the available methods.
